About

Mechanical Engineer with hands-on experience in the aerospace industry, leading the design and development of advanced unmanned aerial systems. Strong research background in UAV aerodynamics, structural analysis, multidisciplinary design optimization (MDO), high-altitude long-endurance (HALE) platforms, and autonomous path planning. Experienced in aircraft design, structural validation, prototype development, and experimental testing.

Previously designed and validated projects include autonomous high-endurance VTOL UAVs, multi-day endurance solar UAVs, fiber-optic guided aerial systems, and loitering munitions.

Research interests span computational aerodynamics, aerospace structures, high-endurance aerial systems, next-generation UAV propulsion, and autonomous mission planning, control & navigation.

Research interests

UAV aerodynamics & flow control

Low-Reynolds-number regimes, aerodynamic shape optimization, vortex dynamics, and flow control strategies for fixed-wing and hybrid VTOL platforms.

Hybrid & green propulsion systems

Design and efficiency analysis of hybrid-electric propulsion architectures for UAVs, with emphasis on energy-efficient and sustainable aviation.

Multidisciplinary design optimization

MDO frameworks integrating aerodynamics, structures, and propulsion for next-generation aerial platforms — including HAPS and long-endurance UAS.

Fluid-structure interaction & aeroelasticity

FSI modeling of flexible UAV structures and morphing wings, structural dynamics under aerodynamic loading, and aeroelastic stability of lightweight airframes.

Autonomous & intelligent aerial systems

AI/ML integration for autonomous UAV flight, mission planning, and control — with applications in defense, surveillance, and advanced air mobility.

High-altitude & long-endurance platforms

Conceptual and detailed design of HALE/HAPS vehicles, with focus on structural efficiency, propulsion integration, and multi-day endurance challenges.

Featured projects

Thesis project2025 · R&D project

Design & development of a high altitude long endurance UAV

Design, development, and experimental validation of a high-altitude long-endurance UAV, from conceptual sizing through prototype fabrication and flight testing. Full aerodynamic, structural, and stability analysis performed using CFD, FEA, and FSI. MDO framework applied to optimize aerodynamic efficiency and structural weight. Avionics integration includes autopilot, autonomous path planning, and energy-efficient flight strategies including thermal soaring. Analysis demonstrates capability for sustained operation at altitudes up to 8,000 m. Successfully prototyped and flight tested.

Freelance project2026 · International freelance

Solar-powered flying wing UAV

Conceptual design, detailed CAD modelling, and aerodynamic–structural evaluation of a solar flying wing UAV for multi-day endurance operation at medium altitude. Full CFD, FEA, and FSI analysis performed using SolidWorks Flow Simulation and Structural Solver, with aerodynamic stability evaluated in OpenVSP and XFLR5. Avionics integration includes autopilot system, autonomous navigation, and thermal soaring strategies for extended endurance beyond battery limits.
